steps.title: Stepped shaft 120 +/- 2: extrude the 55 diameter
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as stepped_shaft.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the YZ Plane (the end). Draw a circle 55 diameter on the origin.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Distance 50 (50 +/- 1 on the drawing). OK.

steps.title: Stepped shaft 120 +/- 2: extrude the 40 diameter
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the end face. Draw a circle 40 diameter, concentric.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Distance 70 (70 +/- 1), Join. OK. Overall 120 (120 +/- 2).

steps.title: Stepped shaft 120 +/- 2: chamfer both ends
actions: Chamfer: Distance 1, select the two end edges. OK. Save.
steps.note: PowerPoint 9 slide 5 gives the lengths 50 +/- 1, 70 +/- 1 and 120 +/- 2 but no diameters; 55 and 40 are scaled from the slide.
